summary: LHP Partners is a Parramatta chartered accountancy and Xero Gold Partner offering tax, bookkeeping, payroll and virtual CFO services. Partner Deborah Liu's firm profile highlights digital and AI solutions within client finance processes, and the firm runs Xero-connected app implementations (Hubdoc, Ignition and others).

hooks.text: Deborah's bio is explicitly about bringing digital and AI solutions into client finance processes: warm to a tool that automates reconciliation.
Xero Gold Partner already rolling out Hubdoc/Ignition: tool-forward, with reconciled Xero files feeding monthly virtual CFO reports.
Efficiency is a stated firm value and the practice is lean (four partners) relative to 2,000+ clients.

risks.text: Another Deborah Liu (ex-Ancestry CEO) dominates search results; do not conflate. Evidence used here is from lhppartners.com.au and the Parramatta LinkedIn profile.
Deborah already positions herself as an AI/digital adopter; may have preferred tools or build in-house.

gaps: No recent LinkedIn posts, podcasts or videos by Deborah or Cliff Wang found.
Third-party LinkedIn data lists 1-10 employees vs 20+ on the firm's About page.
No news or press coverage found.

first.subject: Reconciliation at LHP Partners
first.body:

I built Vert to turn hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with a trail you can trace rather than AI that guesses.
